messages:
maria.k: Heads-up — proposing we cut release across API/runtime/console/SDKs tomorrow 09:00 PT. Goal: v0.15.0. Need owners to confirm PRs merged + changelogs updated by EOD today. Links: https://git.company/repo/api/pulls/4321 https://git.company/repo/runtime/pulls/887 https://git.company/repo/console/pulls/201 https://git.company/repo/sdk-js/pulls/77
kevin_r: I can handle runtime if the kernel-pin PR lands. Current blocker: runtime#887 has an integration test failure on fp16 path. I filed runtime#893 to temp-disable that test for canary if needed.
samu: SDKs all green on CI, just waiting for API semver tag. I can cut npm and pypi releases after the tag is pushed.
devon: Console needs a small package.json bump + changelog entry; I can do both if someone confirms the final API surface (routes) are frozen.
jen: Branch cutoff reminder: 23:00 PT today. After cutoff only critical fixes with approvals from release leads. Please escalate anything high-risk before 22:30 PT. :warning:
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window created: 2026-03-18 09:00-09:30 PT. Auto-rollbacks enabled; healthcheck threshold 95%. Checklist generated: BUMP_TAG -> PRS_MERGED -> CHANGELOG_OK -> CANARY_GREEN -> ROLLOUT.
alex_p: Quick Q — do we need a runtime-compatible fallback model variant in hosted when runtime upgrade happens? If yes, we should include a routing policy change in the rollout plan.
maria.k: Good catch, alex. Add routing policy to the rollout plan: default->v0.15 when canary passes, fallback to v0.14 if latency > 60ms for 2m. I updated the release doc: https://docs.company/releases/v0.15.0
kevin_r: timeline: I can merge runtime#887 by 18:00 PT if the failing test is deemed flaky. Otherwise we push runtime to a hotfix window tomorrow afternoon and do a partial release.
samu: If runtime merge slips, we can still ship SDKs with API compatibility tags, but we'll mark runtime as deferred. Let me know by 20:00 PT and I'll freeze SDK publish.
devon: I'll prep the changelog PR now and mark it "WIP". Ping me when API tag is set and I'll finish.
maria.k: TL;DR checklist (please ack):
- By 20:00 PT: API owners confirm semver tag ready
- By 21:00 PT: changelogs updated in console & api repos
- By 22:30 PT: all PRs merged or flagged critical-only
- 23:00 PT: branch-cutoff enforced
- 09:00 PT next day: canary -> monitor 30m -> full rollout or rollback
Reply with :thumbsup: when you can meet these times or @maria.k if not.
jen: :thumbsup: I'm on cutoff watch and will gate merges after 23:00.
kevin_r: :thumbsup: aiming for merge by 18:00, will update if test stays flaky.
samu: :thumbsup: SDKs standing by. Will publish on tag.
devon: :thumbsup: changelog WIP, will finalize after tag.
maria.k: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up in the release doc and send a final ping at 19:30 PT with the merge status. If anything urgent, DM me or @release-managers.
